resources.string: Names and terms the model should prefer (e.g. company names, product names, abbreviations).
Terms separated by commas or on separate lines. The model gets them as context, so it is more likely to spell them correctly. A few dozen words are enough, a longer list is shortened.
Fixes words the model hears differently: \"dee eye => DI\".
One rule per line in the form \"heard => written\". Whole words only, letter case does not matter.
Saves the vocabulary, replacements and custom cleanup instructions to a JSON file.
Adds terms and replacements from a file (existing ones stay), replaces the custom instructions.
Shows unfinished text while you speak (the Verbalo keyboard and the floating button). Uses the NPU and battery more.
Not downloaded. Tap to download 2.6 GB from Hugging Face (litert-community), Wi-Fi recommended. It downloads in the background and runs only on the phone.
Not downloaded. Tap to download 3.0 GB from Hugging Face (litert-community), Wi-Fi recommended. It downloads in the background and runs only on the phone.
Text from the floating button is inserted as Whisper transcribed it (except in apps where cleanup is turned on below).
Without the downloaded model the text is inserted unedited.

Fixes transcription errors, punctuation and slips of the tongue. Turns enumerations into bullets and splits e-mails into paragraphs, depending on the content and the app you write in. The text is inserted a few seconds after the dictation ends.
The same everywhere. Tap to choose apps where you want only the transcript (e.g. an AI chat), or cleanup instead.
Default. Tap to edit (style, form of address, what to change and what not).
Custom (%1$d characters). Tap to edit or restore the default.
The system prompt for Gemma. The dictation is passed between <dictation> tags, with the target app and the text before the cursor above it. Examples in the instructions help a small model the most.
A build for the Snapdragon 8 Elite (3.0 GB, downloaded separately). Faster and easier on the battery than the GPU. If the NPU fails, the text is inserted unedited.
Tap to switch: default → cleanup → transcript only. Transcript only is inserted while you speak, without waiting for Gemma. The target app is recognized only when text insertion into fields is on.
A dictation button over all apps. First allow \"Display over other apps\" (tap).
A dictation button over all apps. It needs microphone access.
On. Tap the button to dictate, tap again to stop. Drag to move.
A dictation button over all apps, without switching keyboards.
On: dictation from the floating button is inserted at the cursor.
Off: the dictation ends up on the clipboard. Tap to open Accessibility → %1$s and turn the service on. It reads only the field being typed into.
Not downloaded. Tap to download 2.0 GB directly from Qualcomm (2.2 GB on disk), Wi-Fi recommended. It downloads in the background and an interrupted download resumes.
Please accept the privacy policy and license first.
Please grant the \"Allow only while using the app\" microphone permission in settings to continue.
Cancel recognition and switch to the previous keyboard
Recognition is finishing, please wait or cancel.
